title: The First Calendar
question: What is the importance of the dots, lines, and symbols engraved on stone, bones and ivory?

meanings.usage: 指在硬物上刻字或图案
指大象的长牙，也可指类似质地的物质

meanings.meaning: 令人困惑的；使人眼花缭乱的
meanings.usage: 形容数量多或复杂让人难以理解
根据已知信息进行逻辑推理得出结论
指重要事件或时期的到来
找出两个或多个事物之间的相互关系
用图画或文字描述某人或某事
没有固定住所、逐水草而居的人
指发展过程中的一个阶段，或月亮的盈亏
帮助解决问题或找到答案的信息
使某事更易理解或解释
耕种土地、生产农作物的活动

examples.en: Future historians will be in a unique position when they come to record the history of our own times.
examples.zh: 未来的历史学家在着手记录我们这个时代的历史时，将处于独特的地位。

examples.en: They will be able, as it were, to see and hear us in action.
examples.zh: 可以说，他们将能够看到和听到我们的一举一动。

examples.en: Even seemingly insignificant remains can shed interesting light on the history of early man.
examples.zh: 即使是看似不重要的遗迹也能揭示早期人类历史的有趣线索。

examples.en: Up to now, historians have assumed that calendars came into being with the advent of agriculture.
examples.zh: 到目前为止，历史学家一直认为日历是随着农业的出现而产生的。

examples.en: It has long been known that the hunting scenes depicted on walls were not simply a form of artistic expression.
examples.zh: 人们早已知道，墙上描绘的狩猎场景不仅仅是艺术表现形式。

examples.en: They have found that it is connected with the passage of days and the phases of the moon.
examples.zh: 他们发现它与日月的推移和月相有关。

examples.en: For then man was faced with a real need to understand something about the seasons.
examples.zh: 因为那时人类确实需要了解季节的变化。

examples.en: It seems that man was making a real effort to understand the seasons 20,000 years earlier than has been supposed.
examples.zh: 看来人类早在人们想象的2万年前就在努力了解季节的变化了。

examples.en: What is more, they will not have to rely solely on the written word.
examples.zh: 更重要的是，他们不必完全依赖文字记载。

examples.en: It is, in fact, a primitive type of calendar.
examples.zh: 实际上，这是一种原始的日历。

sentences.en: Future historians will be in a unique position when they come to record the history of our own times.
sentences.zh: 未来的历史学家在记录我们这个时代的历史时将处于独特的地位。

sentences.en: They will hardly know which facts to select from the great mass of evidence that steadily accumulates.
sentences.zh: 他们将很难知道从不断积累的大量证据中选择哪些事实。

sentences.en: What is more, they will not have to rely solely on the written word.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，他们不必仅仅依赖书面文字。

sentences.en: Films, videos, CDs and CD-ROMs are just some of the bewildering amount of information they will have.
sentences.zh: 电影、视频、CD和CD-ROM只是他们将拥有的令人眼花缭乱的信息中的一部分。

sentences.en: They will be able, as it were, to see and hear us in action.
sentences.zh: 他们将能够，可以说，看到和听到我们的行动。

sentences.en: But the historian attempting to reconstruct the distant past is always faced with a difficult task.
sentences.zh: 但是，试图重构遥远过去的历史学家总是面临一项艰巨的任务。

sentences.en: He has to deduce what he can from the few scanty clues available.
sentences.zh: 他必须从仅有的稀少线索中推断出他所能推断的一切。

sentences.en: Even seemingly insignificant remains can shed interesting light on the history of early man.
sentences.zh: 即使看似微不足道的遗迹也能为早期人类的历史提供有趣的线索。

sentences.en: Up to now, historians have assumed that calendars came into being with the advent of agriculture,
sentences.zh: 迄今为止，历史学家一直认为日历是随着农业的出现而产生的，

sentences.en: for then man was faced with a real need to understand something about the seasons.
sentences.zh: 因为那时人类确实需要了解一些关于季节的知识。

sentences.en: Recent scientific evidence seems to indicate that this assumption is incorrect.
sentences.zh: 最近的科学证据似乎表明这个假设是错误的。

sentences.en: Historians have long been puzzled by dots, lines and symbols which have been engraved on walls, bones, and the ivory tusks of mammoths.
sentences.zh: 历史学家长期以来一直对刻在墙壁、骨头和猛犸象牙上的点、线和符号感到困惑。

sentences.en: The nomads who made these markings lived by hunting and fishing during the last Ice Age which began about 35,000 B.C. and ended about 10,000 B.C.
sentences.zh: 制造这些标记的游牧民族在最后一次冰河时期（约公元前35,000年开始，约公元前10,000年结束）靠狩猎和捕鱼为生。

sentences.en: By correlating markings made in various parts of the world,
sentences.zh: 通过关联世界各地制作的标记，

sentences.en: historians have been able to read this difficult code.
sentences.zh: 历史学家已经能够解读这个难懂的密码。

sentences.en: They have found that it is connected with the passage of days and the phases of the moon.
sentences.zh: 他们发现它与日子的流逝和月亮的盈亏有关。

sentences.en: It is, in fact, a primitive type of calendar.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这是一种原始的日历。

sentences.en: It has long been known that the hunting scenes depicted on walls were not simply a form of artistic expression.
sentences.zh: 长期以来人们都知道墙壁上描绘的狩猎场景不仅仅是一种艺术表现形式。

sentences.en: They had a definite meaning, for they were as near as early man could get to writing.
sentences.zh: 它们具有明确的含义，因为它们是早期人类最接近书写文字的形式。

sentences.en: It is possible that there is a definite relation between these paintings and the markings that sometimes accompany them.
sentences.zh: 这些绘画与有时伴随它们的标记之间可能存在明确的关系。

sentences.en: It seems that man was making a real effort to understand the seasons 20, 000 years earlier than has been supposed.
sentences.zh: 看来人类早在比人们猜测的20,000年前就在真正努力理解季节了。

exercises.prompt: “表示在将来某一时刻之前已经开始并持续进行的动作，强调动作的持续性。” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 主语 + will have been + 动词-ing
options: 虚拟语气在suggest后的宾语从句中的用法
过去完成时在间接引语中的使用
将来完成进行时 (Future Perfect Continuous)
exercises.explain: 将来完成进行时 (Future Perfect Continuous)：主语 + will have been + 动词-ing：用于强调一个从过去开始、持续到将来某时的动作

source.title: 将来完成进行时 (Future Perfect Continuous)

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
They will hardly know which facts to select from the great mass of evidence that steadily accumulates.
options: 古玩店对许多人来说都有一种特殊的魅力。
他们将很难知道从不断积累的大量证据中选择哪些事实。
在夏季，修道院非常繁忙，
他是故意选择他所过的这种生活的，并且完全清楚这种选择的后果。
exercises.explain: They will hardly know which facts to select from the great mass of evidence that steadily accumulates. — 他们将很难知道从不断积累的大量证据中选择哪些事实。

source.en: They will hardly know which facts to select from the great mass of evidence that steadily accumulates.

grammar.title: 将来完成进行时 (Future Perfect Continuous)
grammar.definition: 表示在将来某一时刻之前已经开始并持续进行的动作，强调动作的持续性。
grammar.structure: 主语 + will have been + 动词-ing
grammar.usage: 用于强调一个从过去开始、持续到将来某时的动作

examples.en: By the time they finish, they will have been working for ten hours.
examples.zh: 到他们完成时，他们将已经工作了十个小时。

grammar.title: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect)
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的动作或存在的状态，对现在造成影响或持续到现在。
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于描述过去的动作或状态与现在的联系，或从过去持续到现在的情况

examples.en: Historians have long been puzzled by dots, lines and symbols.
examples.zh: 历史学家长期以来对点、线和符号感到困惑。

examples.en: Recent scientific evidence seems to indicate that this assumption is incorrect.
examples.zh: 最近的科学证据似乎表明这个假设是不正确的。

grammar.title: 名词性从句 (Noun Clauses)
grammar.definition: 由连接词引导的从句，在句中起名词作用，可作主语、宾语、表语等。
grammar.usage: 用于表达复杂的概念或思想，使句子更加正式和学术化

examples.en: What is more, they will not have to rely solely on the written word.

examples.en: What is the importance of the dots, lines, and symbols?
examples.zh: 这些刻在石头、骨骼和象牙上的点、线和符号有什么重要意义？
